title: Social learning drives underprioritization of collective challenges
summary: Societies often struggle to prioritize important challenges in a timely manner, with substantial costs from delayed action on issues like climate change and pandemic mitigation. A persistent puzzle is that broad concern on issues often fails to translate into collective priority. We argue that a key driver lies in how concern is formed across competing issue domains. Some issues depend heavily on social learning, where individuals infer importance from others, often because direct experience is limited. Others depend more on individual learning from firsthand experience. We develop a dynamic…
